formal_expression: DefinitionComplete(d) iff StableId(d) and ExactScope(d) and FormalVoice(d) and NonNormativePlainVoice(d) and NonNormativeDomainVoice(d) and Boundaries(d) and AdmittedSources(d) and RegistryPostimage(d) and GeneratedIndex(d) and CurrentDriftRoute(d). DefinitionComplete(d) does not imply Admitted(d).

notation.d: One stable Definition identity at one exact version, evaluated together with its declared review package.
notation.StableId; ExactScope: Identity and exact version; authority scope, applicability and exclusions. A filename or classification label cannot supply these silently.
notation.FormalVoice: One normative statement with applicable formal expression, notation, boundary conditions and testable conditions.
notation.NonNormativePlainVoice; NonNormativeDoma: Explicitly explanatory voices that retain the same scope and meaning; they cannot independently extend the normative statement.
notation.Boundaries; AdmittedSources: Declared meaning limits and exact source standing admitted for the applicable target use. Authored candidates can expose unresolved source gaps, but those gaps block promotion readiness.
notation.RegistryPostimage; GeneratedIndex: Declared proposed registry and reproducible lookup projection for the exact version. Completeness requires resolved package material, not merely a placeholder reference.
notation.CurrentDriftRoute: Accountable owner, audit and challenge route applicable to the selected scope and current review inputs.
notation.DefinitionComplete(d); Admitted(d): Structural/governance completeness of the declared package and separately selected owner admission. Neither a schema pass nor an evaluated example selects admission.

interpretation_standing: author interpretation; mechanized assurance not executed
operational_interpretation: Author one exact candidate with its stable identity, scope and three aligned voices.
Select the exact applicable admitted carrier and compatible review/evaluation route; record any unresolved bindings.
Prepare source/owner/consumer evidence, generated projection, registry/index postimages and drift route.
Inspect scoped distinction, consistency and fidelity evidence; preserve unsupported obligations.
Assess pre-decision eligibility independently of the future owner selection.
Only a separate exact owner decision and applicable application can advance current authority.
scope_limits: Schema validity is a representation check, not DefinitionComplete.
CompleteIds is a domain criterion; DefinitionComplete is a Definition governance/package criterion.
Historical admission is not a claim that old references meet every later endpoint/profile contract.
The same individual holding different roles does not merge those role determinations.
